QUOTE: Calls `removeCurrentUserFromChannel`, so the channel is dropped locally; If it is the current channel, runs `handleKickFromChannel(..., CHANNEL_ARCHIVED)`; always removes the user from the channel locally
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The table states that when archived channels aren't viewable (`'false'`), the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if it is the current channel. When viewable, the channel is kept and `delete_at` is stamped, which means marked deleted.
